nodes.label: Mobile Port-In Initiated
nodes.desc: Mobile Port IN by Retail Agent. Journey reuses the Mobility Postpaid Activation process end-to-end, with MNP-specific requirements layered in.

nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: MOI Validation
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: Existing Customer Check
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: Customer Creation
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation. Includes: display of HRN information, Contact Creation, Email Verification.

nodes.label: Customer Eligibility
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation. Includes: Blacklisted or In Collections Check, Line Count Check, Save Milestone.

nodes.label: Billing Profile Setup
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: Capture MNP Details
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to capture the Mobile Number Portability details based on MNP identifier selected.
controls: System shall mandatorily capture the MNP details if MNP identifier is selected.

nodes.label: Cart Eligibility, Base Plan, Add-on & Discount Selection
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation. Includes: Base Plan Selection, Add on Selection, Discount Selection.

nodes.label: Cart Creation
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: Number Selection (Port-In)
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view the Port-In Number captured from the MNP details provided earlier.
controls: System shall auto-populate the MNP Number.
System shall restrict adding any other MSISDN (than the Port-In Number).

nodes.label: SIM Allocation & Inventory Depletion
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation. Includes: SIM Inventory Depletion.

nodes.label: Key Information Display
nodes.desc: System shall be able to display the Key Information of the CAF Terms and Conditions in the UI.
controls: Key Information shown: Plan Selected, MNP Number, Lock-In Period.
These must be shown to Agent before CAF submission.
Final Cart and Key Information must match; if anything changed in Cart before submission, the CAF Submission Key Information must also be uplifted and shown to the Agent.

nodes.label: CAF Generate
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: CAF Submission
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: MNP Form Generation
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to generate the MNP Form based on the information captured in MNP Details, capture Customer signature and upload the MNP Form.
controls: System shall not allow proceeding without capturing the MNP form.
Data limit: 2MB max size, type PDF or JPG.

nodes.label: Validate Cart
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: Payment Processing
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: Order Submission
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to submit the order in UI. Agent shall handover the New SIM to the customer and educate customer about the MNP port-in process. Customer is expected to initiate the Port-In request as advised by the agent.
controls: System shall reduce inventory for the assigned SIM selected in the order.
System shall pass the MNP Identifier to downstream systems.

nodes.label: Customer Notification — Submission
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: Customer Sends Port-In SMS
nodes.desc: Agent guides customer to send SMS to Port-In ("Switch" SMS to 151) to NPAS and wait until the Port-In request is approved by the donor operator. Customer shall send the SMS from the mobile number to be ported in within 24 hours of the Port-In order submission.
controls: If SMS is not sent within 24 hours, the Port-In request will be cancelled.

nodes.label: NPAS Receives Port-In SMS
nodes.desc: NPAS shall receive the Port-In SMS from the customer.
controls: All Port-Ins and Port-Outs are processed by Sender/Donor operators between 10:45 AM and 12:00 PM Qatar time.
Port-In can be scheduled only on working days (Sunday to Thursday).
If a Port-In request is submitted on Thursday, it is processed only on Sunday.
Ports can be scheduled up to a maximum of 30 calendar days from the Port-In request date.
All these rules are offline and not enforced through the system.

nodes.label: NPAS Approves Port-In?
nodes.desc: If NPAS approves the Port-In, the request is forwarded to the donor network. If NPAS rejects, a Port-In Cancellation SMS is sent to the customer.

nodes.label: Port-In Cancellation SMS Sent
nodes.desc: NPAS rejects the Port-In request; a Port-In Cancellation SMS is sent to the customer.

nodes.label: Donor Network Validates Request
nodes.desc: Once the donor operator receives the Port-Out request from NPAS, it must be processed within a 2-hour window. Donor Network validates the request through preset criteria and sends a confirmation to NPAS.
controls: The SLA communicated to the customer for Port-In completion is 48 business hours.
Port-In Request will be automatically Accepted if the customer clears the outstanding amount within the 24-hour conditional acceptance window.

nodes.label: Donor Network Confirmation
nodes.desc: Donor Network sends one of three confirmations to NPAS: Accepted (no outstanding dues), Rejected (criteria not matching), or Partially Accepted (outstanding bills exist).

nodes.label: Port-In Order Update
nodes.desc: System shall wait for MNP request confirmation from NPAS to proceed with order execution or cancellation.

nodes.label: MNP Rejection
nodes.desc: System shall cancel the Port-In order if NPAS provides rejection.

nodes.label: MNP Acceptance
nodes.desc: System shall proceed with the Port-In order if NPAS provides acceptance.
controls: System shall process the order from the downstream system for network, inventory activation and provisioning.
System shall create new inventory for the MNP MSISDN.
System shall associate the SIM details with the MNP MSISDN.
System shall mark the SIM and MSISDN as activated.
Post network activation and inventory update, System shall send the activation towards billing.

nodes.label: Network, Inventory & Billing Activation
nodes.desc: Downstream systems process network, inventory activation, provisioning, and billing activation for the ported-in MSISDN.

nodes.label: Order Completion
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: Customer Notification — Completion
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation.

nodes.label: Port-In Complete
nodes.desc: Customer's number has been ported in and activated; completion notification sent.

nodes.label: Port-In Cancelled
nodes.desc: Port-In order cancelled following NPAS/donor rejection.
